title: Action by majority.
bodyText: If there is more than one arbitrator, the powers of an arbitrator shall be exercised by a majority of the arbitrators, but all of them shall conduct the hearing under section 658A-15(c).
bodyHtml: [§658A-13]  Action by majority.  If there is more than one arbitrator, the powers of an arbitrator shall be exercised by a majority of the arbitrators, but all of them shall conduct the hearing under section 658A-15(c). [L 2001, c 265, pt of §1]
